outcomes.meaning: Batch operation completed for some units; per-unit status in items[].
Batch operation ran but no unit succeeded; per-unit codes in items[].
Cancelled by the user (Ctrl+C, declined plan, MCP cancellation).

errors.meaning: Defect in the tool or an unexpected exception.
Unknown command or option, wrong type, value out of range or not allowed, missing required option, violated exclusion rule.
Referenced file, resource, station, project or identifier does not exist.
Operation conflicts with current state: version collision, lock held, identifier taken.
Remote service failed: timeout, connection error, HTTP error, download failure.
Feature needs an extra or an external program that is not installed; hint names the install command.
Data read by the tool (input file, archive, sidecar, stored series) is malformed or violates its format.
Data store or cache cannot be used: missing marker, locked, unreadable, network share disconnected.
Reading or writing files failed: permissions, no space, path missing.
Path outside allowed directories, write attempted in read-only mode, insufficient role.
Input is valid but no result can be computed: no convergence, series too short, numerical failure, transformation failed.
Request is valid but the source has no data for the area, period or product requested.
Request is valid but this combination is not supported: no safe CRS transformation, product not offered for the country, operation outside the tool's scope.
Cancelled by the user or by SIGINT.
REST only: missing or invalid credentials.
REST only: HTTP method not supported by the route.
REST only: client exceeded a rate limit; Retry-After is set.
